VELOCITY RUSH — ORIGINAL BUNDLED SOUNDTRACK

逐光海岸 / Sunline Drive
132 BPM · D minor · 32 bars · 58.1818 seconds

午夜脉冲 / Night Pulse
140 BPM · A minor · 32 bars · 54.8571 seconds

Both recordings were composed and synthesized specifically for this game.
No sampled recordings, commercial tracks, external music services or remote
audio URLs are used for the built-in soundtrack. The MP3 files are included in
the deployed site and loop through Web Audio after the first user interaction.

Rebuild source: scripts/build-bgm.py (Python, numpy, scipy, ffmpeg).
The arrangement contains synthesized kick, snare, hats, bass, pads, arpeggios
and an original lead motif. Circular note tails make each 32-bar file loop.
These original assets may be used and modified with this game project.
